title: 374Water Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-15
summary: 374Water Inc. (ticker: SCWO), a micro-cap company trading on Nasdaq Capital Market, filed an 8-K on April 15, 2026 disclosing the appointment of Richard H. Davis to its Board of Directors effective April 10, 2026. Mr. Davis, age 69, previously served on the Board from February 2008 to June 2025 and previously served as CEO of the company's predecessor PowerVerde Inc. The filing also notes Mr. Davis is coordinating with management on potential financing opportunities expected to exceed $120,000 if consummated.
